thread:
Jamal: Quick heads-up 1: we ran the quarterly pattern detector and flagged 5 recurring signatures. Need owners + short deliverables so we can fold into the SRE roadmap. Can people volunteer?
Tess: I'll take "db-conn-pool-exhaust" 1: triggers under bursty tenant loads. I'll sketch a fix (backpressure + circuit) this week.
Lina: I'll own "model-rollback-flap" 1: repeated rollbacks when new weights hit higher latency. I'll add pre-deploy perf gates.
Ethan: I'll take "prefix-eviction-thrash" 1: cache eviction storms for multi-tenant prefixes; looks infra+runtime.
Jamal: Great. Please paste 1-line acceptance + target date here. We need to be able to close follow-ups automatically.
Tess: Acceptance: max waiters on pool < 5 for 99th pct under 2x burst; Delivery: 2026-05-05.
Lina: Acceptance: deploys with latency regression blocked by perf gate; Delivery: 2026-04-30.
Ethan: Acceptance: reduce prefix-eviction incidents by 90% in synthetic replay; Delivery: 2026-05-12.
Jamal: Which need infra work or approvals?
Tess: Might need DB config change (connection limits per tenant) and a small schema-safe migration. Will open INFRA ticket.
OncallBot: New ticket created: INFRA-3101 "db per-tenant pool caps + migration plan" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3101
Lina: No infra changes immediately but I'll ask eng-runtime to add the perf-gate hook to the deploy pipeline.
Ethan: Need kernel flag toggles to change hugepage behavior for eviction tests. Tagging OncallBot to open a request.
OncallBot: New ticket created: INFRA-3102 "kernel flag toggles for eviction test harness" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3102
Jamal: Please add the originating PMT id when you post PRs so we can close the postmortem follow-up rows.
Tess: Will reference PMT-2091 in the PR and add a regression test.
Lina: Using PMT-2104. Adding a canary checklist to the PR template.
Ethan: Adding PMT-2120 and a synthetic replay job to the CI matrix.
Jamal: Also: recommend tenant-level mitigations for repeat offenders. Any opinions?
Tess: For the DB pool issue, top offender tenants should be throttled or moved to dedicated pools until the fix lands. I'll add a recommendation row.
Lina: For model rollbacks, add a temporary pin to the stable model for affected customers and notify CS.
Ethan: For prefix thrash, recommend per-tenant prefix quotas and a soft-deny path.
Jamal: Action recap:
- Tess: db-conn-pool-exhaust 1: acceptance + 2026-05-05 1: INFRA-3101 1: PMT-2091.
- Lina: model-rollback-flap 1: acceptance + 2026-04-30 1: PMT-2104.
- Ethan: prefix-eviction-thrash 1: acceptance + 2026-05-12 1: INFRA-3102 1: PMT-2120.
Jamal: I'll create rows in the incident-patterns tracker and schedule a mid-sprint check next Wednesday. Weekly reminders ok?
Tess: Weekly check OK. Please mark 'recurring' if owner expects cross-quarter work.
Lina: I'll mark model-rollbacks as recurring until perf gates prove stable for 2 releases.
Ethan: I'll need one pairing session with runtime to instrument eviction counters. Ping me.
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: recurring check every Wed 09:00 UTC for this thread.
Jamal: Thanks all 1: I'll post the tracker link in the doc and update when PRs are open. Any blockers now?
Tess: None from my side, starting work today.
Lina: Filing a small RFC for the perf gate changes.
Ethan: Scheduling a kernel toggle window with infra for tests on 2026-04-02.
Jamal: Perfect. Closing for now, will follow up after next week's check.
